title: Cardinality of a finite abelian character group over a splitting field
statement: Let $E$ be a finite abelian group, written multiplicatively, and let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. Write $e=\exp(E)$ for the least positive integer such that $g^e=1$ for all $g\in E$. Let $\mu_e(k)=\{z\in k^\times:z^e=1\}$. Assume that $\mu_e(k)$ is cyclic and contains an element of order exactly $e$. Then the group $E^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}(E,k^\times)$ of group homomorphisms, with pointwise multiplication, is finite and has cardinality $|E^\vee|=|E|$. Moreover, characters separate points: for every $g\in E$ with $g\ne1$ there is $\lambda\in E^\vee$ with $\lambda(g)\ne1$.
